prescribedGeometry.description: Exact C2 prescribed display paths for twelve ordered coaxial architrino worldlines with a central radius envelope and opposite circulation senses on two declared index subsets; no acceleration balance, binding, retention, stability, or physical realization is implied.

choices: The twelve architrino worldlines have distinct orbit centers ordered along one common z axis.

The transverse radii increase toward the center of the train and decrease toward its ends; equal axial spacing, common frequency, and the displayed phases are representative coordinates rather than analytical acceptance claims.
The two machine index subsets have circulation senses +1 and -1 and do not satisfy the three-common-midpoint constraint of a B1 component.
